budget.failed_or_unpriced_calls: Keep full reservation charged until cost is reconciled; do not retry automatically.

cohort_rule: First four eligible unseen PR families by ascending number from the next metadata inventory of open PRs. Exclude drafts and PRs without changed Go files. Record all exclusions and pinned base/head before inference and labels. Do not replace cases based on scores or labels.

evaluation.utility: Proposed source bytes only; do not infer downstream token or quality savings.

labels.blinding: Separate no-tools sessions receive identical pinned code, rubric, unit IDs; no scores, other labels, GitHub comments or predictions. Same provider/model means correlated evidence, not independent model diversity.
labels.rubric: review: changed code implements or directly tests access/tenant/object authorization, disclosure, identity isolation, executable capability/effect-ceiling boundaries. routine: generic plumbing, fixtures, algorithmic correctness, evidence integrity or pure serialization without such a changed boundary. unknown: supplied evidence cannot resolve relevance. Provide source witness; relevance is not confirmed defect truth.

name: authorization-triage-v10
ontology_work: Build measured source/evidence projection with snapshot identities, typed observed relationships and explicit unresolved coverage. Do not add features or retrain incumbent during this cohort.
sample_rule: At most 24 functions per family, lowest SHA256(seed,unit_id), seed=shoal-v10-20261002, selected before inference/labels. Report full declaration/file dispositions.
stop_rule: Four eligible family samples or eight paid calls or budget exhausted. If insufficient families exist, retain a pending cohort; no retrospective substitution.
temporal_strata: Existing-at-registration PRs measure prospective assessment of newly observed snapshots, not future-created PR generalization. Separately identify any PR created after registration. Do not combine these claims.
